how.title: How it works
how.verifyBody: Prove you're one human with World ID, by Orb or document, and a sponsor pays for your first bundle. Do it on the phone that will use the eSIM: the activation code opens only in the browser that claims it.
how.installBody: Three ways, all on the install screen. Needs an eSIM-capable, carrier-unlocked phone.
how.installHere: On this phone: tap Install eSIM on an iPhone, or paste the code into Android's settings.
how.installQr: From another screen: scan the QR code with the phone.
how.installManual: By hand: type the SM-DP+ address and the activation code.
how.topupBody: Add {mb} at a time for {price} in USDC; it lands on the same eSIM. Data stops when the plan expires.
how.giftBody: Send data to an ENS name. They claim it with their wallet or the 16-digit PIN; if they don't, you can reclaim the USDC.
how.agentBody: An agent buys {mb} when your plan runs low, up to a daily cap. You approve it with World ID.

plan.shareText:
Your Recharge eSIM activation code:
{lpa}

To install it:
1. Open Settings > Mobile data (Cellular) > Add eSIM.
2. Choose "Enter details manually" or "Use activation code" and paste the code above.
3. Turn on the new line for mobile data, and Data Roaming if the phone asks.

Usage and top-ups: {link}

event.reclaimTerms: Only eligible eSIMs that were never installed or used can be cancelled. After the provider confirms cancellation, Recharge reimburses the original sponsor’s wallet at the claim price. Provider credit and this treasury payment are separate; installed or used profiles are excluded.
event.reclaimUnavailable: Unused-eSIM reimbursement is unavailable unless the selected provider explicitly supports cancellation before installation.
event.reclaimOff: This campaign does not request cancellation or reimbursement for claimed eSIMs.
event.ticketNotice: Every attendee needs a private organizer-issued ticket pass and a unique World ID claim. A public campaign link alone does not grant access.
event.datesInvalid: Enter valid event dates, a future claim deadline no later than the event end, and a recovery date at or after the event end.
event.packageDates: Choose a package whose installation window and validity cover the event. Unknown activation timing is not supported.

event.unspentTerms: The budget refund returns only funds never spent on a claim. Reimbursement for a claimed eSIM is separate and requires confirmed eligible provider cancellation.
tickets.title: Attendee data passes
tickets.intro: Use your own ticket references to issue one private data-pass link per attendee. Recharge does not connect to or verify an official ticketing API.
tickets.privacy: Keep these links private. Distribute each one through your organizer’s ticketing email or attendee channel.
tickets.refHint: One reference per line, up to 200 per batch. References are case-sensitive; repeats recover the same pass. Use opaque references, not attendee names or emails.
tickets.issue: Sign to issue or recover passes
tickets.invalidRefs: Enter 1–200 valid ticket references, each at most 128 characters.
tickets.failed: Passes could not be issued. Check the wallet and try again with the same references.
tickets.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it manually.
tickets.closed: Issuing passes is unavailable while this campaign is paused or closed.
tickets.ownerNeeded: Connect the campaign’s sponsor wallet to issue private passes.
tickets.distribute: These are private attendee links. Copy them individually or export a local file. To recover them later, sign again for the same references.
tickets.statusHint: Reserved means the pass is bound to an attendee’s verified claim; activation may still be pending.
landing.ticketIntro: Attending an event? Open the private data-pass link from your organizer before you travel. Organizing one? Fund destination data and distribute passes to your ticket holders.
